title: Multi-teacher based knowledge distillation for retinal vessel segmentation
mechanism: Specialist teachers trained on modified ground truth (original, thin-only, thick-only); student distils all of them.
adaptation: Teacher A house (native labels), teacher B crack labels dilated 3-5 px (recall teacher), teacher C inactive specialist (oversample 42 inactive cells), teacher D PF (E1 inactive 0.24); student CE(GT) + per-class teacher mix (crack from A+B, inactive from C+D).
min_experiment: Arm: 4-specialist KD student, 3 seeds. Baseline: house single and Noothout KD arm. Metric: relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90, inactive IoU, E1 inactive IoU. Kill: relR@2 < +0.015 and inactive IoU < +0.02.
evidence: R: two fundus and two angiography sets; up to +8.44 F1 and +10.42 IoU over baseline U-Net.
prior_overlap: none; dilated labels never used as a teacher (Skeleton Recall / offset-tolerant CE are different mechanisms)
